stops.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1993_European_Grand_Prix ('Senna set the fastest lap on lap 57, on a lap when he drove into the pit lane but aborted the pit stop'); https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/may-1993/18/opportunity-knocked
stops.note: drive-through, no stop (tyres not ready): pit-lane transit only; tyre 'slick': the slicks stayed on (no stop)

notes: Stop counts: Senna 5 pit calls incl. the drive-through (Motor Sport; Wikipedia says four stops), Hill 6, Prost 7, Herbert 1 (slicks after about lap 10), Barrichello at least 4. Missing laps: Senna's late wet stop and one more, Hill's other 4, Prost's other 3, Herbert's one, Barrichello's later ones. No safety car is mentioned in Wikipedia, Motor Sport or GrandPrix.com (https://www.grandprix.com/gpe/rr535.html), but no source states there was none: safetyCars left incomplete for the owner to confirm. Weather: Senna's wet stop between his lap-18 and lap-34 slick stops (GPE: 'Senna stayed out for four more laps' after Hill's lap-24 wet stop, so about lap 28) and his closing-laps wet stop ('10 laps to go') have no exact lap, so he runs slicks through those showers; Prost's lap-48/53 stops and Hill's later stops have no tyre, so those stints are estimated.
